name: Rice
notes: fact: Pires records a separate rice volume measure and reports Pegu shipping reaching Melaka in late March and April (docs/research/prices.md §2; docs/research/monsoon-calendar.md §3; Pires I, pp. 98–99; II, pp. 277–278).
inference: Overlapping Pegu and Java supply can ease seasonality, but delays to major rice fleets leave the city exposed (docs/research/prices.md §4.2; docs/research/monsoon-calendar.md §§3, 5).
gameplay: Base index from docs/research/prices.md §5; the monthly and stock percentages are tuning values, not historical prices or rates.
